central_topic: Foundational sources for a Mondrian least-ambiguous-set split-conformal procedure with gated covariate-shift weighting, evaluated against LAC, APS, RAPS and class-wise LAC baselines on compositional (softmax) outputs.
core_methods: Likelihood-ratio weighted conformal prediction under covariate shift with classifier-based density-ratio weights
benchmarks: Evaluator-generated synthetic softmax families (no real dataset used); no benchmark retrieval needed
architectural_shifts: Gated domain-classifier importance weighting added to Mondrian LAC calibration

queries.query: least ambiguous set-valued classifiers with bounded error levels
queries.rationale: Gap target baseline-score-sources (Method, 'Baselines, negative controls and validity conditions'): LAC (threshold on 1-p_y) is a headline baseline and the base score of the proposed method, but its defining paper is not cited.

queries.query: classification with valid and adaptive coverage adaptive prediction sets APS
queries.rationale: Gap target baseline-score-sources: APS (randomised cumulative-mass score) is one of the four baselines in the best-baseline margin claim and has no citation.

queries.query: uncertainty sets for image classifiers using conformal prediction regularized adaptive prediction sets RAPS
queries.rationale: Gap target baseline-score-sources: RAPS (APS with rank penalty) is a baseline in the headline comparison and is uncited; this query is paragraph-specific to the baseline description.

queries.query: Mondrian conformal prediction category-conditional validity inductive split conformal foundations
queries.rationale: Gap target mondrian-split-conformal-foundations (Method, 'Statistical background'): the Proposition and rank argument are called textbook but unsourced, and Mondrian calibration is the core of the method; only recent conditional-validity papers are in the bibliography.

queries.query: conformal prediction under covariate shift weighted exchangeability likelihood ratio
queries.rationale: Gap target weighted-conformal-shift-and-compositional-framing (Method, 'Weighted calibration under covariate shift'; Related Work, 'Positioning'): the gated weighting with test-point mass at +infinity rests on weighted conformal under covariate shift, which is uncited and has no Related Work paragraph despite shift being an evaluation axis. Classifier-based density-ratio weights are covered here by the same retrieval rather than a separate query.

queries.query: Aitchison statistical analysis of compositional data log-ratio geometry simplex
queries.rationale: Gap target weighted-conformal-shift-and-compositional-framing (Introduction and Related Work 'Positioning'): the draft frames softmax outputs as compositions and invokes log-ratio compositional data analysis without a source. Single foundational query only.

forbidden_query_patterns: further applied, clinical, time-series or tutorial conformal prediction papers
CIFAR-10 or other real-image dataset queries (draft is synthetic-only)
queries duplicating class-conditional, group-conditional, length-optimisation or long-tailed conformal papers already in references.bib (Gibbs, Ding, Kiyani, Shi, Bairaktari)
queries about quantitative results already grounded in paper_data.json
